**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Avoid double-sending runtime messages in callback fallback**

In callback-only browser runtimes, this helper sends the same envelope twice: once in the probe call (`runtime.sendMessage(message)`) and again in the callback fallback path below, so a single DataFn request can execute two mutations/transactions and return inconsistent state. This only appears when `sendMessage` does not return a Promise, but in that environment it is a correctness bug for every proxied request.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Validate content script target scopes against extension targets**

`validateContentScriptShape` never checks `contentScript.targets`, so typos or out-of-scope targets are accepted and later silently filtered out of every manifest by `buildManifest` instead of failing fast. In practice, a mis-scoped content script can disappear from all shipped targets with no configuration error, which is hard to diagnose and breaks expected injection behavior.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Resolve Vite CLI path from package, not caller cwd**

This command hardcodes `node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js` under the caller's cwd, which fails when `vite` is installed nested under `@superfunctions/extfn-cli` (for example, version conflicts or non-hoisted installs) or when the CLI is run globally. In those common npm layouts, `extfn build` crashes before invoking Vite even though the CLI's own dependency is present.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

P1: The message is sent twice on callback-based runtimes (e.g. Chrome MV2). The first `runtime.sendMessage(message)` on the probe path dispatches the message even though its return value is discarded; then the fallback `new Promise` path sends it again with a callback. Combine both paths into a single `sendMessage` call to avoid the double-dispatch.
Prompt for AI agents ```text Check if this issue is valid — if so, understand the root cause and fix it. At datafn/extfn/src/authority.ts, line 400: The message is sent twice on callback-based runtimes (e.g. Chrome MV2). The first `runtime.sendMessage(message)` on the probe path dispatches the message even though its return value is discarded; then the fallback `new Promise` path sends it again with a callback. Combine both paths into a single `sendMessage` call to avoid the double-dispatch. @@ -0,0 +1,415 @@ + } + + try { + const maybePromise = runtime.sendMessage(message); + if (maybePromise && typeof (maybePromise as Promise).then === "function") { + return maybePromise as Promise; ```
